name: rc-issue
description: Write an issue about a prompt and keep it under docs/issues/, named by a sequence number, the date it was made and a slug. Activate when a prompt begins with the /rc-issue marker or the /lpr-issue marker, or when a prompt asks to create an issue or to create this as an issue and the user answers yes to 'Is this an RC issue?'. Commands - rc-issue, record.
author: UAK35
